summary: Iteration 30 — P0 navigation + Realm mobile regression batch (6 fixes). All 6 fixes verified GREEN end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_widget_xl_size.py — PATCH /api/communities/realm/dj/widgets/{wid} accepts size='xl' (200 + persists), rejects size='banana' (400), legacy 'wide' + 'tall' still accepted (back-compat), and full S/M/L/XL matrix succeeds. Frontend Playwright on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: (1) STAR BAR — data-testid 'star-bar' renders on /home, /feed, /sounds, /realms, /realms/dj, /friends, /messages, /profile with the 5 items in spec order star-featured → star-discover → star-notifications → star-messages → star-profile-edit. Each click navigates to /featured, /discover, /notifications, /messages, /profile respectively. Profile chip lands on /profile (edit view) as specified, NOT /public/stealth. (2) BOTTOM NAV — data-testid 'bottom-nav' renders on every authenticated page with the 7 items in spec order bottom-home → bottom-foryou → bottom-sounds → bottom-create → bottom-realms → bottom-friends → bottom-profile. bottom-profile correctly lands on /public/stealth (public view). bottom-create opens 'What are you creating?' overlay with all 5 options (live/video/image/sound/thought). Discover is NOT in bottom nav (correctly removed). (3) /discover deep-link still renders Discover page (no 404). (4) BANNER FIRST-TAP — at viewports 320×700, 375×800, 430×900: realm-banner-edit has computed z-index=2 and touch-action=manipulation; the gradient overlay sibling has pointer-events:none. realm-banner-editor modal appears after a SINGLE click at all three viewports. (5) MEMBER ACTION SHEET — clicking community-member-tfone opens member-action-sheet; clicking member-action-profile transitions URL to /profile/tfone (NOT /@tfone). (6) WIDGET EDIT TOGGLE — initial state: realm-widgets-edit-toggle shows 'Edit widgets' with data-active='false', 0 realm-widget-controls-* in DOM. After click: button text 'Done', data-active='true', each of 4 widgets renders 5 children — realm-widget-size-{small|medium|large|xl}-<id> + realm-widget-drag-<id>. Tapping each size button sets data-active='true' on that button only and PATCHes the widget (200) — sizes persist on reload. NO HORIZONTAL SCROLL on any size at viewports 320/375/414/430 on /realms/dj, /realms, /home, /feed (bodyW === innerWidth throughout). Click 'Done' again → controls + add chips disappear. (7) NON-ADMIN VIEW (tfone) — realm-widgets-toolbar is hidden entirely; no realm-widgets-edit-toggle, 0 realm-widget-controls-*, but the 4 widget tiles still render and member can vote/post; no horizontal scroll at 320. (8) REGRESSION — /messages, /notifications, /featured, /admin, /admin/support, /admin/realm-pulse, /sounds, /friends, /profile, /public/stealth all load with 0 console errors (excluding pre-existing AutoplayVideo errors for seeded broken video URLs, which are unrelated to this batch).
critical_code_review_comments: TopStarBar.jsx (lines 11-16): the 4-item ITEMS array + the trailing star-profile-edit button render in spec order. data-active toggles based on location.pathname match. Profile chip explicitly routes to /profile (edit) — correct per spec.

BottomNav.jsx (lines 13-22): ITEMS_LEFT [Home, For You, Sounds] + center create button + ITEMS_RIGHT [Realms, Friends, Profile]. Discover removed from bottom nav as required. bottom-profile target overrides to /public/<username> on line 421-423 when user is logged in — matches spec.

RealmWidgetGrid.jsx: SIZES=['small','medium','large','xl'] with 1-column-only spans (SIZE_SPAN.col always 'span 1'), so vertical-only growth prevents horizontal overflow on 320–430. The auto-fit grid uses minmax(min(280px,100%),1fr) so a single widget on a 320px viewport shrinks instead of forcing scroll. editMode prop gates showControls — read-only by default.

RealmDetail.jsx (lines 187-200): banner gradient overlay has style={{pointerEvents:'none'}} so taps fall through to the realm-banner-edit button below it; the edit button itself has zIndex:2 + touchAction:'manipulation' to ensure first-tap fires on iOS Safari (verified via getComputedStyle in tests).
MemberActionSheet.jsx line 95: navigate(`/profile/${member.username}`) — correctly uses the registered route. /@username would have 404'd.

backend/routers/realm_widgets.py (lines 119, 165): allowed size set is {small, medium, large, xl, wide, tall} — 'xl' added, 'wide'/'tall' retained for back-compat. Validator returns 400 on anything else (verified with 'banana').

Minor (non-blocking): RealmWidgetGrid stores size into local state only via parent's onChanged; size buttons have a no-op short-circuit when activeSize === requested size — saves a redundant PATCH. Good.

Minor (non-blocking): TopStarBar.jsx star-bar nav uses overflow-x-auto with scroll-snap on mobile. The notification badge is rendered as a child SPAN inside the notifications button with its own data-testid (star-notifications-badge) — this shows up in a flat data-testid scan but is not a sibling of star-* items, so the strict left-to-right order is preserved at the button level.

Minor (non-blocking): /api/videos/abc.mp4 + a couple of seeded .mov files in the feed produce MEDIA_ELEMENT_ERROR console noise on /feed, /home. Pre-existing seed data issue, unrelated to this batch — flag for product cleanup if desired.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 12 acceptance items in the request validated across 4 viewports)

test_credentials: Founder stealth/Password1$ via POST /api/auth/login with {email:'stealth', password:'Password1$'}; member tfone/pass1234. Token stored in localStorage('ourrealm.access') for protected routes.
seed_data_creation: None. Test only modifies an existing widget on /realms/dj momentarily and restores its original size in finally{}. No persistent test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Star bar, bottom nav, banner first-tap, member action sheet → /profile/{username}, widget grid edit-mode toggle + S/M/L/XL size buttons + no-horizontal-scroll invariant, and the backend xl/wide/tall size validator are ALL green. Useful testids for follow-up: star-bar (children star-featured/discover/notifications/messages/profile-edit), bottom-nav (children bottom-home/foryou/sounds/create/realms/friends/profile), realm-widgets-toolbar, realm-widgets-edit-toggle (data-active flips), realm-widget-tile-<id>, realm-widget-controls-<id>, realm-widget-size-{small|medium|large|xl}-<id> (data-active='true' on the saved one), realm-widget-drag-<id>, realm-banner-edit (z-index:2, touch-action:manipulation), realm-banner-editor (modal), member-action-sheet, member-action-profile, community-member-<username>. Note: viewport height must be tall (>=4000) so widget grid mounts below the chat/members panels on mobile-width tests.
